summary:
Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three new keyword-triggered ECS rules with unit tests. Nothing committed.

Files added (all untracked, no existing files edited):
- src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py (E3052)
- src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py (E3053)
- src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ServiceFargate.py (E3054)
- test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/test_service_network_configuration.py
- test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py
- test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/test_service_fargate.py

Test results:
- ECS unit tests: 72 passed.
- test/unit/rules plus test/unit/module/test_rules_collections.py: 988 passed.

Environment caveat: the shared venv's cfnlint is an editable install pointing at tasks/.../base/src, so plain runs import the wrong code. I ran with PYTHONPATH set to this repo's src/ and did not modify the venv.

Formatting: black and ruff are not installed in the venv, so I could not run them. I checked line lengths manually (all under 88 columns). Two spots may be reflowed by black.

Implementation choices:
- Each module has its own small private resource-name helper. I did not share one across modules.
- The "at most one error per pair" rule is enforced per service/task-definition pair.
- For multi-branch values (Fn::If), an awsvpc or FARGATE match in any branch triggers the check.
- The E3054 required-property error path is the task definition's Resources/<name>/Properties.
- Test fixtures use no conditional-branch case for E3054, because the template has no condition definitions to evaluate.
